create_filter_particle_drop: create a particle drop simulation using mujoco MjModel and MjData with a batch filter estimator
run_filter_update: run the filter update loop with control and noisy sensor measurements over a 100-step rollout
initialize_filter_state: initialize the filter with state, covariance, and process and sensor noise parameters
render_particle_drop_video: render and display a particle drop simulation video with mujoco Renderer and mediapy
plot_filter_estimates: plot simulation ground truth, noisy sensor, and filter estimate for height and velocity over time
